$Comment: A Burning Grave Candle, what the Gravekeeper burns to open the Headless Horseman's hard ride (Hallows_Eve_Graveyard_Hard.json's EntryCost). Requires opens it once Old Jack counts the player a Regular (Friendly with Old Jack's Favor); a locked offer still shows on the shelf with its lock line, so a player can see what to work towards. No purchase limit and no rotation. SortOrder 6 puts it straight after the plain Grave Candle on the lanterns shelf. Cost is the price in Hallow Sweets. Named by the item's own keys.
